name: Picmal
tagline: Convert, compress, and batch-edit images, video, audio, and PDFs on your Mac.
description:
Picmal groups common media jobs into a desktop app. Drop in a batch of files to convert formats, shrink assets, or prepare them for delivery without uploading them to a browser service.

## Features
- Resize and convert images, remove backgrounds, and export app icons.
- Compress or convert video and audio files.
- Merge PDFs and split audiobooks by chapter.

## Privacy and requirements
The developer says file processing stays on your Mac and works offline. Choose the source files and output destination in the app.

## Pricing
A seven-day trial is available. A single Mac license costs $29 once, with multi-Mac licenses also offered.
